description: This file defines the CompatibilityList class, which provides functionality to check GPU delegate compatibility on Android devices within the TensorFlow Lite framework. It includes methods for checking support and managing native resources.

classes.name: CompatibilityList
classes.description: Provides information on GPU delegate support for the current device and manages associated native resources.

methods.name: isDelegateSupportedOnThisDevice
methods.description: Checks if the GPU delegate is supported on the device.

methods.name: getBestOptionsForThisDevice
methods.description: Returns the best GPU delegate options for the device.

methods.name: CompatibilityList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the compatibility list.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases native resources associated with the compatibility list.
